description: This file contains unit tests for the USBDevice module, including tests for device enumeration, device info retrieval, driver binding/unbinding, and event handling related to USB device plug-in and plug-out events. It uses Google Test framework and mocks various USB and system interactions to verify the behavior of the USBDevice implementation.

classes.name: USBDeviceTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing USBDevice functionalities, setting up mocks and environment for each test case.

methods.name: Mock_SetDeviceDesc
methods.description: Mocks the device descriptor information for a given bus number and device address, including setting vendor and model info files.

methods.name: Mock_SetSerialNumberInUSBDevicePath
methods.description: Creates mock serial number files for USB devices and device paths.
